name: Temporary Services 4
definition: Information regarding the billing for services rendered on a temporary or contract basis. The component provides information such as the employee job performed, timekeeping, and billing rates.

CompanyName.name: Company Name
CompanyName.definition: Contains the name of the individual at the contracting company that has requested temporary services.

CompanyDepartment.name: Company Department
CompanyDepartment.definition: Contains the name of the department at the contracting company in which the temporary staff will be working.

CompanyIdentification.name: Company Identification
CompanyIdentification.definition: Identification of the temporary services company.

CompanyBusinessName.name: Company Business Name
CompanyBusinessName.definition: Business name of the temporary services company.

CompanyLegalCorporateName.name: Company Legal Corporate Name
CompanyLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the temporary services company.

CompanyAddress.name: Company Address
CompanyAddress.definition: Address of the temporary services company.

CompanyLocalData.name: Company Local Data
CompanyLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of the temporary services company data.

CompanySupervisor.name: Company Supervisor
CompanySupervisor.definition: Contains the name of the individual at the contracting company that is supervising the temporary staff.

EmployeePersonalIdentification.name: Employee Personal Identification
EmployeePersonalIdentification.definition: Contains the personal ID associated with the individual working in a temporary capacity.

EmployeeIdentification.name: Employee Identification
EmployeeIdentification.definition: Contains the company-provided ID associated with the individual working in a temporary capacity.

EmployeeName.name: Employee Name
EmployeeName.definition: Contains the name of the individual working in a temporary capacity.

EmployeeProfessionalLevel.name: Employee Professional Level
EmployeeProfessionalLevel.definition: Contains the professional level of the individual working in a temporary capacity.

JobCode.name: Job Code
JobCode.definition: Identifies the job or task being performed by the individual working in a temporary capacity.

JobDescription.name: Job Description
JobDescription.definition: Contains the description of the job or task of the individual working in a temporary capacity.

JobStartDate.name: Job Start Date
JobStartDate.definition: Contains the start date of the job.

JobDuration.name: Job Duration
JobDuration.definition: Duration of the job expressed in number of days.

JobEndDate.name: Job End Date
JobEndDate.definition: Contains the end date of the job.

FlatRateIndicator.name: Flat Rate Indicator
FlatRateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not the fee for the individual working in a temporary capacity is a flat|rate.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

TimeSheet.name: Time Sheet
TimeSheet.definition: Contains the time sheet identification number.

WeekEnding.name: Week Ending
WeekEnding.definition: Contains the date of the end of the billing cycle.

ChargeRate.name: Charge Rate
ChargeRate.definition: Contains rate details of the temporary service charges.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Contains the amount of taxes assessed for temporary services.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount includes amounts of all expenses and total tax amounts, minus discount amount.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
